headline: Attacks on logistics have affected 90% of Ukrainian business
summary: Russian attacks on warehouses and logistics have affected nine in ten Ukrainian enterprises, which report higher resource and transport prices and supply risks.
why: Logistics disruption raises costs and supply risk for businesses, weighing on output, trade flows and the broader economy.
